blocks.html: Every chapter of life tells a different story—one that evolves with your dreams, priorities, and aspirations. Whether you’re starting fresh, building a family, or investing in the legacy you’ve always envisioned, finding a home that fits your story can be both exciting and overwhelming. That’s why RLC Residences, the residential arm of Robinsons Land, is redefining the home-buying journey with thoughtfully designed properties that empower you to embrace your next chapter with confidence.
For forward-thinking home-seekers, RLC Residences has an impressive portfolio of pre-selling properties.
More Choices

Early buyers enjoy more options—from prime unit locations and stunning views to diverse layouts that suit every lifestyle. RLC Residences gives you the power to choose where your next chapter unfolds. You’re in control of the life you’re building—no compromises.
More Time

Pre-selling means flexibility. With stretched down payment terms of up to 78 months depending on the project, you can secure your future home today without compromising your present. Moreover, waiting for your unit turnover provides a crucial window to plan out your home design, such as thoughtfully buying furniture, appliances, and more. RLC Residences allows you to say yes to your future at your own pace, giving you ample time to plan, save, and design the life you want.
More Confidence

Behind every RLC Residences project is a track record built on trust and excellence. Every home is thoughtfully designed with smart features, balanced amenities, and strategic accessibility, ensuring that what you’re buying into is more than a dream— it’s already in motion.
RLC Residences’ pre-selling portfolio features developments tailored to different life stages, whether you’re seeking freedom, stability or legacy.
For the Young and Independent – Sierra Valley Gardens
Perfect for young, independent individuals ready to start their next chapter, Sierra Valley Gardens offers a future-ready home that’s both modern and mindful.

Located along Ortigas Avenue Extension in Cainta, Rizal, this dynamic condominium combines accessibility, sustainability, and smart technology. Part of the 18-hectare Sierra Valley Destination Estate, it’s surrounded by retail and leisure spaces for ultimate convenience. Designed with nature and efficiency in mind, it showcases open green areas, a hydroponics farm, solar panels, and built-in smart home devices—a first in the East.
With unit options from 22 sqm studios to 67.5 sqm two-bedrooms, it’s where independence meets smart, sustainable living, making it your smart move in the East.
For Starting and Growing Families - MIRA by RLC Residences

Perfect for families looking to build their next chapter, MIRA offers a thoughtfully designed, family-centric community in Quezon City. This pre-selling condominium sits on a 9,583-sqm property strategically located near schools, business districts, hospitals, and transport hubs, ensuring everyday convenience and connectivity.

Designed for comfort and growth, MIRA features safe, family-friendly amenities such as study and play areas for kids, family function halls, work zones, a pet park, and active outdoor spaces like glamping areas, pools, and an outdoor movie zone. With studio, one- and two-bedroom units, smart home features, spacious layouts, and storage solutions, MIRA empowers families to live efficiently, securely, and meaningfully.
For the Accomplished and Wealth Builders - Le Pont Residences

Designed for the accomplished and those on their wealth-building journey, Le Pont Residences offers a rare balance of sophistication, sustainability, and smart living. Located in Bridgetowne Destination Estate and spanning 7,220 sqm within the estate, this pre-selling condominium provides direct access to both Quezon City and Pasig, placing residents close to key lifestyle and business hubs like Opus Mall, GBF Centers 1 and 2, and other office buildings.

An EDGE-certified development, Le Pont ensures eco-friendly premium living with spacious, smart home–ready units ranging from 43 sqm to 390 sqm, each featuring a private loggia. Here, every element—from high-end finishes to resort-style amenities— reflects a life of fulfillment and ease. With hyper-sized amenities designed for productivity and leisure including Private Theater, Golf Simulator, and Executive Function Villas, Le Pont Residences is truly a haven with an investment edge.
Designed for What’s Next

RLC Residences’ commitment to quality, innovation, and integrity has cemented its reputation as one of the country’s most trusted real estate developers. With a robust and continuously growing portfolio of vertical and horizontal developments across key areas nationwide, it continues to raise the bar for modern living. Each RLC Residences project is crafted with the discerning homeowner in mind—balancing functionality, style, and sustainability to create spaces that truly elevate everyday life.

From sleek urban condominiums that place you at the heart of thriving business districts, to serene suburban communities, every development reflects RLC Residences’ dedication to enhancing how people live, work, and connect.
No matter where you are in your life’s journey, RLC Residences is ready to create your home—one that celebrates who you are today and who you aspire to be tomorrow.
Begin your next chapter with RLC Residences by visiting rlcresidences.com.
